description: Add captions to a short video (up to 5 minutes). Ask the user for aspect_ratio and caption_style if they're not given. If the user says 'just pick,' default to aspect_ratio '9:16' and caption_style 'minimalist'. Jobs take 3-8 minutes; Vugola will email the user when done, and the agent can check status via get_clip_status.
name: caption_video
